title: Card Charge for Spent Instant Store Credit (Returns & Exchanges)
content:
**Returns & Exchanges — customer action reference: charging spent instant store credit to the original card.**

## The rule

On a Store Credit Return whose instant store credit, issued at the first carrier scan, is larger than what the return is owed once inspected, credited and charged its fees, a negative difference is recovered from the Return Store Credit issued at the scan up to its current balance, and the part already spent is charged to the original card only on the cardholder's own authorization.

The amount charged to the original card for spent instant credit is fixed only after every line accepted at inspection on the return carries its credit entry. That card charge is not worked out until every line with units graded B on the return carries its restocking fee entry.

## What the action does

`authorize_spent_credit_charge_4aac9d1c` is the cardholder's own authorization for Marlowe & Finch to charge the card used on the original order for the part of a Store Credit Return's instant store credit that inspection and fees left unearned and that has already been spent. One recovery entry from the original card is recorded on the return, dated today; it lowers what the customer owes back on the return by the amount charged. After the call the charge appears among the return's settlement entries as a recovery from the original card.

## How it is invoked

This action belongs to the customer. The agent unlocks it by its exact name, `authorize_spent_credit_charge_4aac9d1c`, and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, as the cardholder. The agent does not run it on the customer's behalf.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `return_id` | The RMA number of the Store Credit Return the instant credit was issued on, as the agent reads it out from the return lookup | Identifier, exactly as shown |
| `charge_amount_usd` | The amount the cardholder authorizes on the original card | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent, exactly as the agent states it |

## What comes back

- **Success:** a confirmation sentence naming the recovery entry reference (a reference beginning "rs"), the RMA number and the amount charged to the original card in USD with 2 decimal places. The entry reference means the charge was authorized and recorded.
- **Error:** when no return exists under the RMA number given, the action answers "Error: no return" with that number and records nothing.
